title: Split Range Primitives (Naked Range)
pattern: Representing ranges (dates, currency limits, physical boundaries) as separate, adjacent primitive fields.
why_bad: It allows the creation of invalid ranges (e.g., `start_date > end_date`), requiring every consuming method to write redundant validations checking lower and upper bounds.
detection: Function arguments or struct fields representing upper and lower bounds (e.g., `start_` and `end_`, `min_` and `max_`) of the same primitive type.
counterexample: Passing completely independent timestamps that do not define an interval logic or limit invariant.
source: *Refactoring* by Martin Fowler (p. 278); *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (p. 268).
